articles.title: How Aussie Bitcoiners can avoid 2027’s shock CGT hike: Part 1
articles.snippet: From setting up an SMSF or a company, to just leaving the country entirely, here are some strategies Australian Bitcoiners can employ to deal with 2027’s massive CGT hike.

articles.title: Justin Sun seeks $264K sanctions over World Liberty’s UAE disclosure

articles.title: Ethereum dev targets 2028 for quantum resistance, a year early

articles.title: Tether Holds 150,000 Bitcoin, CEO Says—About 50,000 More Than Its Reserve Report Shows
articles.snippet: Paolo Ardoino told the Plan ₿ Forum in Lugano the company owns “give or take 150,000 Bitcoin,” but its Q3 reserve report implies just 100,060.
